name: Bajaj Finserv Ltd
title: Bajaj Finserv Ltd - 532978 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Multi-line insurance and lending holding; Q4 PAT +5% reported (+24% ex-MTM), GI combined ratio 113.6% on timing, Life VNB +29% with NBM 24.5%; no capacity or pricing-cycle signal for insurers.

triggers.label: GI pricing discipline amid competition
triggers.quote: where we feel the pricing is not appropriate, as we have been doing all these years, we go slow

triggers.label: Life VNB +29%, NBM 24.5%
triggers.quote: our VNB for the quarter grew at a very healthy 29% up from INR 549 crores to about INR 709 crores

guidance.metric: Life VNB growth and product mix
guidance.quote: we would want to have, you know, a PAR at about 25% plus-minus
I think we are about two years from that is what we have envisaged
the break-even AUM for us would be close to about INR1 lakh crores

red_flags.label: GI combined ratio 113.6% in Q4
red_flags.quote: The combined ratio for the quarter was elevated at about 113.6% for the quarter as against 104.8%

red_flags.label: Persistency decline in Life
red_flags.quote: persistency dips were observed against certain cohorts in line with the market

red_flags.label: Management evasion on margin guidance
red_flags.quote: We will, not provide any affirmation or otherwise from us on margins

evasions.quote: We will, not provide any affirmation or otherwise from us on margins if you're going to indicate like this, please.
I don't see that there's a huge shift in terms of the release happening
